applies_to: Every non-trivial execution/setup/review/test/external-material/long-loop request. Trivial one-shot tasks may use NONE mode but must still preserve boundaries.
changed_judgment_rule: If space does not change the plan, say NO_CHANGED_JUDGMENT and why. If it does, name the exact space ref and changed decision.
codex_rule: Codex is not called by default. Codex receives reentry after Hermes execution, or a retrieval request only when fresh unknown space refs may change judgment.
gemini_rule: Hermes never direct-calls Gemini. Gemini is Codex-side only when Codex judges layer ambiguity and user/budget permits.
purpose: Make Hermes execution start like VectorFL: preserve original, orient in space, reason with model over original+space, execute, then produce trace/reentry for Codex maturation.

space_reference_modes.CODEX_MATURATION_REENTRY: After Hermes execution, for Codex to deepen space later.
space_reference_modes.CODEX_RETRIEVAL_REQUEST: Only when fresh unknown space reference may change judgment; Hermes does not fake it.
space_reference_modes.DEEP_ARTIFACT: When compact surfaces are insufficient; descend to immutable trace/receipt/source index.
space_reference_modes.FULL_HISTORY: Cross-arc or structural task; read full-history sync and selected root artifacts.
space_reference_modes.LITE_LENS: Setup/reinterpretation/test task; read lite cards/lens/index roots.
space_reference_modes.NONE: Trivial local one-shot; no durable VectorFL space needed.
space_reference_modes.QUICK_BOARD: Known lane or current-position check; read first board/summary/pointers.
